_doc: Task #122 (r6): declared field layouts for the render objects. Same shape as data/field_names.json ({class: {offset: {name, confidence, summary, evidence}}}) with three added keys per field: width (bytes), type (null = not known from evidence), status ("typed" or "unknown"); optional count and member_of. Class-level facts are under the top-level key "_classes"; keys starting with "_" are not classes. Evidence is the game code (address + instruction), the runtime-class descriptors, d3d8.h/d3d8caps.h/d3d8types.h/d3dx8tex.h prototypes and the IDA library signature of _D3DXCreateTexture@32; see batches/r6_122_render_objects.md.

CDx.size_source: runtime-class descriptor 0x103299C8 (returned by slot 0 0x10008F80 `mov eax, 0x103299c8`): name "CDx", size 0xA50, parent 0x103515A0 = CYyObject (size 4); the one allocation 0x100161C8 `push 0xa50` before the constructor call 0x100161EF
CDx.identified_by: Its own runtime-class descriptor names it. The object is the one in g_pCDx (0x1045666C): the only non-null write, 0x100161F6, stores the result of the constructor 0x10008F90 (which stores vtable 0x103299D4 at 0x100090C3) run on the 0xA50-byte allocation; the two other writes store 0 (0x100162B8, 0x10016376). Accesses counted: every [reg+disp] whose register was loaded from [0x1045666C] (772 functions), plus `this` in 45 functions whose every direct call passes that object in ECX and whose address appears nowhere in the image (list in the .md).

CYyModel.identified_by: Descriptor. `this` proven only in the constructor 0x1002B4B0 (stores vtable 0x1032A75C at 0x1002B4EE), the destructor 0x1002B550 (stores it at 0x1002B556) and 0x1002B530 (this_class.json). No other function was reached with this object from the code; the tree places 11 more by IDB name (not used for types here).

Obj_SkinAndDrawV2_this.identified_by: The object 0x1002DC10 (tree: CYyModelDt::SkinAndDrawV2) and 0x1002F1D0 (Model_SkinVerticesCpu) run on. 0x1002DC10's only call, 0x1002A02F, passes ECX = 0x10072FB0([CYyModelDt+0x8]) (the handle's target), not the CYyModelDt; 0x1002F1D0's only call, 0x1002DDF4, passes 0x1002DC10's own this (ebx). Neither address is taken. Its class is not settled by the code read. Dword fields at unaligned offsets (+0x36, +0x42, +0x5E) show a packed (file-image) layout.
